description: This file contains validation functions for Kubernetes webhook configurations, including URL validation, CA bundle validation, and service validation.

methods.name: ValidateCABundle
methods.description: Validates the provided CA bundle bytes by attempting to create a TLS configuration.

methods.name: ValidateWebhookURL
methods.description: Validates that a webhook URL is well-formed, uses HTTPS if forced, and does not contain disallowed URL components.

methods.name: ValidateWebhookService
methods.description: Validates the namespace, name, port, and URL path of a webhook service configuration.
